//: Copy this file to appsettings.Development.json (which is git-ignored) and fill in local dev values. Never commit real secrets.

ConnectionStrings.//SqlServer-local: Matches the docker-compose SA password (default Your_password123 or your MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD override). Local dev may use TrustServerCertificate=True.

Jwt.//SigningKey: Any local dev secret >= 32 bytes. Generate a strong random value for anything shared.
